args.name: Root propagation and tending
args.function: Provide a learnable practical method to propagate and tend edible meadow roots, if their actual biology permits it, for a renewable local food supply.
args.conditions: A meadow-root plant is visible at (10.1,12) on ordinary soil. Root nutrition is known to be 14 with zero toxicity. Whether these plants can be propagated, and suitable growing conditions, are unknown and must be established through evidence.
args.inputs: Potential inputs include viable root material and suitable soil; exact requirements are unknown.
args.costs: Method, learning time, labor, material requirements and growth time are unknown; none should be assumed free or instantaneous.
args.effects: Enable actual planting and tending only after any required learning and with real inputs and elapsed growth time. Successful growth and harvest must be observed, not granted by this request.

candidates.function: Plant one owned root unit in a small soil plot as a persistent trial, inspect a plot by direct observation, or take back remaining planted material; resume or cancel unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit (quantity 1); two work rounds at one energy each, at an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; supply inputStackId. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: one round and 0.2 energy, the baseline probe observation of a plot in reach (target). Remove: one round and 1 energy, planter only (target). Tend is unavailable and spends nothing. No tools or water are granted.
candidates.effects: Completed planting places the real root unit in the plot; it keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Plot state records stage, observation rounds, soil moisture and temperature/rain exposure. There is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule for roots, so a plot never produces food. Inspect records only visible state. Remove returns only the material that physically remains, never a replacement; the emptied plot remains. Cancel releases unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for planting, inspecting or removing; genuine observed changes use the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The related-capability search and exact cultivate-plant contract establish that planting, inspection and recovery already exist, but propagation, physiological growth and tending explicitly do not. Reusing cultivate-plant alone would not meet the requested renewable-food function. Develop the missing biological trial and tending mechanisms through the current-conversation handoff, extending the existing general cultivation interface rather than inventing an unrelated activity or assuming meadow roots can regenerate. Development waiting does not advance simulation or establish successful propagation.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: cultivate a plant using parameterized planting, inspection, tending and removal modes, with persistent propagation trials. Retain cultivate-plant@1 and handler long.cultivate-plant as the recorded source of reused planting, escrow, inspection and removal code; record the extension and its dependencies explicitly. Reuse probe for evidence recording and gather/forest.gather for any eventual transfer of ripe, exposed stock. Do not claim these mechanisms as new inventions. Applicable actors may independently learn and operate the extension; no automatic mastery or participation is granted.\\nReferences and prerequisites: target is an exact visible plant or plot ID; inputStackId is an exact owned material stack; processId identifies the actor's persistent job; x/y identify a reachable, unoccupied ordinary-soil site. Species/material compatibility must be checked, not inferred from an item's name or food value. start-0-roots at (10.1,12) is the observed source reference, with current stock zero, not a free supply. item-3-lin-12 is a possible input, subject to live ownership, remaining quantity, spoilage and actual suitability checks. Known nutrition 14 and toxicity zero do not prove viability, rooting, environmental tolerance or reproductive mode. The tick-9 visible-state record is an observation, not verified evidence of propagation.\\nSmallest executable addition: connect persistent planted material to a substrate, exposure and organism-state model that can resolve a real propagation trial, and expose only supported tending actions. Before release, the development handoff must inspect the existing source-growth, environmental-decay and simulation-time implementation and implement the missing causal transitions. Establish executable species parameters for viable propagules, suitable conditions, establishment duration, growth, resource demands, failure and harvestable production. These are world-mechanism definitions to validate in the handoff, not facts awarded to Lin. Do not select positive viability merely to satisfy this request. If the actual material cannot propagate, trials must show the supported failure; implement only an alternative propagation mode supported by actual available biology and real inputs. If biological support remains unresolved, preserve the trial as unresolved, with an explicit implementation blocker; do not report biological failure or silently ship the existing never-growing plot as the completed addition.\\nCosts and work: preserve planting at one actual unspoiled root unit, two work rounds and one energy per completed work round. Material moves into escrow once, then into the plot on completion; splitting a stack deducts the same quantity and retains its age and provenance. Inspection costs one round and 0.2 energy. Removal costs one round and one energy, with the existing planter restriction. Each supported tending intervention costs at least one work round and one energy, plus its actual consumed inputs. A minimal hand-tending mode may clear physically present competing vegetation from a small reachable plot; it must transfer that biomass to a recorded residue or waste state and may improve only a modeled competition term. It cannot create moisture, nutrients, viable tissue or food. Watering is enabled only with an implemented owned water source and transfer mechanism, and debits exactly the applied amount. Unsupported modes fail validation without costs or success effects. No tools, water, seeds, fertilizer or additional root units are supplied by development.\\nGrowth costs and timing are not currently known. The handoff must supply positive executable establishment and growth durations in simulation rounds, actual temperature/moisture limits, resource demands, and per-interval production and capacity bounds before growth can execute. Derive these from inspected existing mechanisms where applicable; record any newly authored rules explicitly. Do not invent a maturity deadline in this review. All growth must require elapsed world time under those rules, with no progress during development/review waiting. The extension must maintain state for living tissue, remaining original material, moisture, environmental exposure, elapsed eligible growth, damage, decay and harvestable stock. Existing material continues ageing during trials. Photosynthetic production, if supported, must debit modeled environmental energy and water/nutrient availability and account for biomass, respiration and waste; soil fertility is not an infinite hidden food source. Reuse existing source-growth accounting where compatible, with an explicit ledger preventing both source and plot from crediting the same production. Harvest depletes actual ripe stock and costs the existing gather rate of two energy per unit. Any resulting edible root units retain their actual nutrition/toxicity rules; eating still uses eat and never substitutes mood for nutrition.\\nPersistence and settlement: store resolved references, allocated quantities, work paid, remaining work and process status. Interruption preserves paid progress and surviving escrow; resumption validates reach, ownership and inputs and charges only unfinished work. Cancellation releases surviving unplanted material once, with spent energy/time never refunded. Death settles unfinished escrow to ground once. Already planted material remains a physical plot on interruption, cancellation or planter death and continues ordinary environmental processes; removal returns only physically surviving recoverable material. No operation restores decay losses or manufactures replacement inputs. Failed validation spends nothing; failure after real work retains actual costs and damage. Maintenance is conditional on measured modeled needs, not a mandatory invented chore schedule. Neglect changes growth or survival only through implemented causal conditions. Established transitions, eligibility, accounting, caps and evidence checks execute in code without repeated model review.\",\"learning\":3,\"experienceReview\":\"Learning takes three individual study rounds for the developed operation; this review grants no skill. No reward follows requests, naming, implementation, registration, study completion, elapsed waiting, a query or a success claim. A directly witnessed new biological response or informative trial failure may qualify through the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only when it changes that actor's verified knowledge. Repeated inspection of unchanged state does not qualify. Actual familiar tending or personally meaningful cultivation participation may sustain modest benefit without requiring novelty, but only through implemented event eligibility. Reuse the current experience ledger and its bounded event amounts, per-window caps, cooldown and decay; the configured mental rate 0.04 and decay 0.002 are ceilings/configuration inputs, not permission to create a second reward stream. If an applicable bounded rule is absent, add and test it before enabling any cultivation benefit; default to no award while unresolved. Deduplicate the same event across probe, cultivation and harvest. No automatic comfort, mood, food or health gain from a plot; any physical comfort remains capped at 10. Never modify protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions.\",\"visualReview\":\"Use reusable plant/plot visual metadata and observable events carrying plot ID, source/input provenance, action mode, actor where applicable, simulation time, work progress, observed stage and visible material changes. Reuse the existing plant component where suitable, recording that reuse. Planting completion may display placed material, not a sprout. Emit establishment, growth, visible wilting, decay, tending completion and harvest events only after their corresponding coded state transitions. Show unresolved trials as unresolved and failed trials as failed, not productive or ready. Inspection exposes only reachable observable findings, not hidden viability parameters, future yields or undiscovered environmental data. Harvest visuals must match the actual stock transferred; a learning animation or submitted request cannot display a successful crop.\"}]}"}
